clips.title: The story
paras: Talen, an elf camped near the dangerous Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale, seeks recovery of a lost relic. After being ambushed and run aground by vicious naga, he dropped his prized ancient statuette along the surf and needs an adventurer to retrieve it from the ruins.

The sunken ruins of Zoram along Ashenvale's northwestern shoreline have long attracted those curious about the ancient night elven past. Talen was navigating the shallows in a small vessel when hostile naga surfaced and tore into him with claw and trident. He managed to scramble ashore with bare provisions to make a hasty camp, but in his desperate sprint for survival, his most precious find was dropped into the sands.

The ancient statuette left half-buried on the beach is more than a simple souvenir. Talen considers it the entire justification for braving the monster-infested Zoram Strand. Upon its recovery, he reveals that the drowned city holds centuries of forgotten mysteries, and this delicate carving acts as a vital key to understanding what remains hidden beneath the tides.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I would charge you with a task, friend.

I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.
But when I reached the shore and ran... My prized possession was lost.
Please, friend, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the statuette, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found it! Thank you, friend!
The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
